title: Settings
description: Manage your profile, preferences and privacy settings.

demoAdapter.title: Demo adapter
demoAdapter.body: No server-side profile is available yet. Choices saved here are kept in a demo HttpOnly cookie, for this browser only.

profile.title: Profile
profile.readOnlyBody: The profile comes from the identity provider, which is not configured yet. The information below is fictional and cannot be edited.
profile.name: Display name

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Language, theme and time zone of your workspace.

language.label: Preferred language
language.help: Language is independent from country, currency and time zone. The FR/EN switch in the header changes it temporarily for the session; saving below makes it permanent.

theme.label: Theme
theme.help: The theme applies immediately and is remembered on this device.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: Used to display dates and times. It does not affect any tax rule.

preferences.savedDescription: Demo adapter: kept for this browser only.
preferences.priority: Language priority: temporary header choice, then saved preference, then French (Canada).

security.title: Security
security.providerBody: Password, two-step verification and session management will be available once the identity provider is selected and its contracts are confirmed. No fake security action is offered.
security.sessionBody: Signed HttpOnly demo session, valid for 8 hours. It holds no real personal information and does not exist in production.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Cookies and storage used by the application.
privacy.summaryBody: Escalia uses no advertising cookie, no third-party analytics and no session recording. Only strictly necessary cookies and storage are used, so no consent is requested at this stage.
privacy.legalNote: This qualification must be validated (Quebec Law 25 and other obligations) before any production release.
privacy.consentBody: With no optional processing, there is nothing to accept or withdraw. If optional processing is ever added, it will stay blocked until accepted, and withdrawal will be possible here.

purposes.locale: Remembers the last language chosen by the visitor.
purposes.localeSession: Changes the language temporarily from the header, cleared on sign-out.
purposes.sidebar: Remembers whether the side menu is open or collapsed.
purposes.preferences: Demo adapter for preferences (language, time zone).
purposes.demoSession: Signed demo session. Exists outside production only.
purposes.theme: Remembers the light, dark or system theme.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unavailableBody: Notification preferences cannot be loaded right now.
notifications.emailInvalid: Your email address looks invalid: emails are no longer sent. Update it in your profile.

invalid.time: Enter a start and an end time for quiet hours.

locked.title: Always sent
locked.help: Official notices are always sent by email and in the app: they can have legal effect.

channels.pushHelp: Browser notifications are not offered yet.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.help: Official notices, account alerts and emergencies are never held.
